mainEntity.name: Can I self pace the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This online digital marketing course is an extensive functional and behavioral training which can only be taken up by candidates who are willing to pursue it full time. Since it requires a lot of group work, live marketing sessions, and group feedback, self-pacing our digital marketing course is not an option. You can check out our Part-time Digital Marketing Course, if that suits you better.

mainEntity.name: Is attendance mandatory? What if I miss a digital marketing class? Will I get a make-up class? Or a recorded version of the class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the course is extremely rigorous and thus attendance is a crucial part of your success. You need to mandatorily have attendance >90% for all digital marketing classes, tests and project work. In case of any exceptions, we will ensure that you get a recording - but you will need to get prior approval from the Kraftshala team to do that.

mainEntity.name: What if I want to leave the digital marketing course midway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our job is to train you and get you placed. If we are not able to do this, we will share accountability. Your job is to put in your effort in the digital marketing course. However, if your effort is lacking / you change your mind about doing the course, we won't be able to help you further. In that case you are not eligible for refunds

mainEntity.name: What are the requirements for Kraftshala’s online digital marketing course with placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To pursue Kraftshala’s digital marketing course you must-have : General- You are required to have a laptop and a good internet connection. Basic knowledge of the English language. Interest in digital landscape and marketing. You need to be available to take a full-time job immediately after course completion. Available for full time digital marketing classes on all weekdays + Saturday. Education/ Experience- Cleared 12th standard. No prior marketing experience needed.

mainEntity.name: I have just taken my final exams and have not received my degree yet. Can I still apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can still take up the digital marketing strategy and execution course. Please discuss this with your Admissions Counselor.

mainEntity.name: What is the Kraftshala Changemakers Scholarship and how can I be eligible for it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kraftshala Changemakers Scholarships will be given to folks who do exceptionally well in the admission process. Since they will only be rolled out to 5% of the batch, we will look at a bunch of things - Screening Test scores, your intent towards Kraftshala and how you can contribute to our alumni community. This is based on your first attempt of the Screening Test, if given within 72 hours of submitting your application. If you get the Scholarship based on your Screening Test results, you are eligible for a fee waiver of ₹30,000 on your digital marketing course fees. Please note that if you get enrolled via the Scholarship, you will not be eligible for a refund. The Scholarship discount cant be combined with any other discount (e.g. Propel Discount).

mainEntity.name: I'm interested in the programme but cannot afford the fee. What are my options?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer EMI for students who need to spread the cost. For students from low-income families (with a typical annual household income below ₹6 LPA, however this is not a hard cutoff as we assess each case holistically), we run 8X Impact — a separate merit access track for hand-picked, high-potential students for whom the EMI option is not financially feasible.

mainEntity.name: After completing the online digital marketing course, what kind of job roles can I expect to find?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the Marketing Launchpad by Kraftshala, you get placed in roles like Digital Marketing Analyst, Performance Marketing, Ecommerce Marketing, Programmatic Executive, SEO Analyst, Client Manager, Account Manager, Marketing analyst, Content and Social Media Manager etc.

mainEntity.name: Is the Marketing Launchpad a job guarantee digital marketing course?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Marketing Launchpad is not a job-guarantee program. The program takes accountability for delivering solid results measured by the success of our students (which means jobs, not side projects or freelancing gigs) given that you are putting in the work needed. And post that, if you don't succeed, we will share the accountability with you. If you don't get placed at 4.5L or more post 15 months of training completion, we refund 60% of the fee back. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

mainEntity.name: When do the placements start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Placements begin after the completion of the course timeline, i.e. post 6 Months for the full-time batch and post 44 weeks for the part-time batch.

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to restrict my placements to one city without relocating?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have a constraint to be in one of the following cities for your placements (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune and Hyderabad), then you can opt for our Location Specific model once you get selected for Kraftshala’s digital marketing program. Within this, you will have to pay an additional amount of ₹17,000 + GST for Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Bangalore and ₹19,000 + GST for Pune & Hyderabad. You can make this decision at the time of enrolment or before moving to placements. This fee is to account for the additional effort that the Kraftshala team will put in to bring in more companies operating in a given location as well as the additional risk that the team assumes in placing students in a particular city.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get placed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total 60% of our students get placed by Week 6 of the placement drive. Total 80% of students get placed by Week 8 of the placement drive. Remaining 20% get placed over the next 4-6 weeks as these are students who typically need more help or have a very specific constraint in terms of location etc.

mainEntity.name: What are the terms and conditions for a refund?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’re eligible for a refund when you are not able to get a job that pays you ₹ 4.5 LPA or above within 15 months of the digital marketing course completion. In this case, we refund 60% of your fee. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

mainEntity.name: What will my typical week look like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your training will happen every Sunday from 10 - 7 PM. You will also have some project work for 2 hours on 2 days of the week in the evenings (Tues and Thurs). You get 1 Sunday off after each module to reset :)

mainEntity.name: What am I going to do during the week while I am working/attending college?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will have classes on 2 days of the week for 2 hours each. These could be classes or projects based on what you have learnt on Sunday. Additionally, module interviews (which happen 1-1) or some additional refreshers or sessions might happen depending on your individual / batch progress. These instances will be communicated in advance.

mainEntity.name: What will happen on weekends?

acceptedAnswer.text: The weekend sessions will be a mix of live sessions, recorded modules, doubt sessions with industry experts, case building sessions, group assignments & catch-ups with the academic teams.

mainEntity.name: Will I be expected to spend time over and above the time that I will spend on working on exercises during the week?

acceptedAnswer.text: We would suggest you take out time for self-revision whenever you can in order to strengthen your concepts. We will also be conducting frequent assessments before the Sunday sessions begin.

mainEntity.name: Will I get any live campaign experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you get to run live campaigns as a part of your group project during the course. You will be running live campaigns on Meta and Google Ads during the course.

mainEntity.name: Is the course curriculum different for Part-Time batch Vs Full-Time Batch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - The full-time batch which is a 6 Months (8-10 hours a day) batch includes all topics that Part time course includes plus Search Engine Optimization (SEO). The Part-time batch which is a 11 months long program, will have much more revision sessions for topics being taught as it is a longer program and retention is critical. Thus, to accommodate those revision sessions, we have not included SEO in the Part-Time Curriculum. However, if required, students can be provided with additional training material for SEO once the course period is over for self-learning.

mainEntity.name: What are module interviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Module interviews will be organized before or after classes at the conclusion of each module to assess your readiness in the respective subject matter. Your presence and availability during these designated times are expected. Anticipate a total of 2-3 such mock interviews to be conducted over the course duration.

mainEntity.name: Can I self pace the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This part-time online digital marketing course is an extensive functional and behavioral training which can only be taken up by candidates who are willing to give it their all. Since it requires a lot of group work, live sessions, and group feedback, self-pacing our digital marketing course is not an option. The classes will be on Sunday and 2 hours each on Tuesday and Thursday and it's been designed like that so that all the folks who are working or in college can put in the hours. There will be some additional work during the week which you can self pace though.

mainEntity.name: Will I get a certificate after completing the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the Marketing Launchpad Program is an online digital marketing certification course. After completing the digital marketing training, you will get INDUSTRYCreds® Certification which is recognized by top companies in the industry. But Kraftshala does not provide any degree. We believe in skills > degrees and focus on getting you hired!

mainEntity.name: Is attendance mandatory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the course is extremely rigorous and thus attendance is a crucial part of your success - not just physical but also being mentally aware and present is very crucial for success. You need to mandatorily have attendance >90% for all digital marketing classes, tests and project work. In case of any exceptions, we will ensure that you get a recording - but you will need to get prior approval from the Kraftshala team to do that.

mainEntity.name: What's the selection process like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Step 1: Fill up the application form and get your process started. Step 2: There are 2 parts here. Free Screening Test - This is a 60 min test with 3 questions that evaluates you on your Logical Ability and Decision Making. This has been created in discussion with top experts and has proven to be highly successful in ensuring we assemble a batch of high potential candidates. If you give the first attempt within 3 days, you will also be evaluated for the Kraftshala Changemakers’ scholarship. Career Chat with Admissions team - You also speak to the Admissions Team at this stage to get your doubts clarified and also to know more about the program and its placements. The call also helps us figure out your motivation and intent towards the course. Step 3: Within 3-4 working days, you will get your results. And if accepted, you can complete the payment formalities and enroll and start your journey towards a fantastic career!

mainEntity.name: What is Kraftshala Changemakers scholarship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kraftshala Changemakers Scholarships will be given to folks who do exceptionally well in the admission process. Since they will only be rolled out to 5% of the batch, we will look at a bunch of things - Screening Test scores, your intent towards Kraftshala and how you can contribute to our alumni community. This is based on your first attempt of the Screening Test, if given within 72 hours of submitting your application. If you get the Scholarship based on your Screening Test results, you are eligible for a fee waiver of ₹30,000 on your digital marketing course fees. Please note that if you get enrolled via the Scholarship, you will not be eligible for a refund. The Scholarship discount cant be combined with any other discount (e.g. Propel Discount).

mainEntity.name: When will I get to know whether I am getting the scholarship or not?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will get to know within 3-4 days after giving your Screening Test.

mainEntity.name: Is the Marketing Launchpad a job guarantee digital marketing course?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Marketing Launchpad is not a job-guarantee program. We place each of our students in roles of 4.5L or more. With 3300+ students placed, we are the largest and most reputed trainer and provider of marketing talent in the industry. We measure our success by the success of our students (which means jobs, not side projects or freelancing gigs). Hence we will dedicate every last resource to helping you get the opportunities you deserve. It will, however, not be a free pass. Krafshala requires dedication and hard work from you. We encourage each of you to speak to our alumni and watch their videos here! This is crucial so you understand what you are getting into. You WILL need to put in the work and we will support and cheer you all along. And post that, if you don't succeed, we will share the accountability with you. Thus, if you don't get placed at 4.5L or more post 15 months of training completion, we refund 60% of the fee back. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

mainEntity.name: Am I supposed to apply for all jobs that come in?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You get a certain amount of passes which you can utilize to let an opportunity pass. All the information about the company is made available before you apply. Once applied, you should not back out as it impacts the chances of everyone else as well.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to take the first job I'm offered?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Once the placement process begins, we will recommend you to MNCs and startups in our network. You need to accept the job offer if you clear the selection process.

mainEntity.name: Do I directly get a job of 4.5L+ or do I get to do an internship first?

acceptedAnswer.text: We get both kinds of roles. You can apply to the job after going through all details beforehand. mainEntity.name: If I get an internship first, will that have a stipend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all internships we offer are paid. More importantly, we focus on placing you in roles that provide meaningful work, strong learning, and high-quality exposure.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get placed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once folks move to placements after clearing all assessments, majority students get placed within 6-8 weeks. The bottom 20% take slightly longer (another 4-8 weeks) as these are typically folks who would need more help or have a location constraint that they have opted for. Total 60% of our students get placed by Week 6 of the placement drive. Total 80% of students get placed by Week 8 of the placement drive. Remaining 20% get placed over the next 4-6 weeks as these are students who typically need more help or have a very specific constraint in terms of location etc.

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to restrict my placements to one city without relocating?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have a constraint to be in one of the following cities for your placements (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune and Hyderabad), then you can opt for our Location Specific model once you get selected for Kraftshala’s digital marketing program. Within this, you will have to pay an additional amount of ₹17,000 + GST for Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Bangalore and ₹19,000 + GST for Pune & Hyderabad. You can make this decision at the time of enrolment or before moving to placements. This fee is to account for the additional effort that the Kraftshala team will put in to bring in more companies operating in a given location as well as the additional risk that the team assumes in placing students in a particular city.

mainEntity.name: What are the terms and conditions for a refund?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’re eligible for a refund when you are not able to get a job that pays you ₹ 4.5 LPA or above within 15 months of the digital marketing course completion. In this case, we refund 60% of your fee. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! The Marketing Launchpad Emerging Talent program is a certification course. Once you've finished the training, you'll earn the INDUSTRYCreds® Certification, which many top companies in the industry recognize. Just a heads-up, Kraftshala doesn't offer a formal degree. We're big believers in the idea that skills can often outshine degrees, and our primary aim is to help you land that dream job!

mainEntity.name: Is attendance mandatory? What if I miss any class? Will I get a make-up class? Or a recorded version of the class?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, our course is thoughtfully designed to be comprehensive, so regular attendance plays a significant role in ensuring your success. It is mandatory that you maintain over 90% attendance for all digital marketing lessons, exams, and project work. If there's ever a time you can't make it, just let us know in advance. We'll do our best to provide you with a recording.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility criteria for Kraftshala’s digital marketing course (in Hindi) with placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To be eligible for Kraftshala’s digital marketing course you must have: General - You must have a valid PAN card and Aadhaar Card. You are required to have a laptop and a good internet connection. Can read and write in both English and Hindi at a basic level, and able to understand Hindi. You need to be available to take a full-time job immediately after course completion. Available for full time digital marketing classes (in Hindi) on all weekdays + Saturday. Education/Experience - Cleared 12th standard. No prior marketing experience needed.

mainEntity.name: What if I want to leave the digital marketing course (in Hindi) midway?

acceptedAnswer.text: We're here to guide, train, and help you secure a placement. If for some reason that doesn't happen, we promise to shoulder that responsibility, provided you've been doing your part. It's essential that you bring your commitment and enthusiasm to the table. By staying engaged, attending all the required sessions, meeting timelines, and seeking assistance when needed, you significantly increase your chances of success. Remember, most students who give their best effort often succeed, even if it takes a second attempt. However, if you decide the course isn't for you or if we notice a drop in your commitment, we might find it challenging to support you further. Please note, in such instances, refund requests may not be entertained.

mainEntity.name: What's the selection process like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Step 1: Fill up the application form and get your process started. Step 2: There are 2 parts here. Free Screening Test - This is a 60 min test with 3 questions that evaluates you on your Logical Ability and Decision Making. This has been created in discussion with top experts and has proven to be highly successful in ensuring we assemble a batch of high potential candidates. Give practice test here. Career Chat with Admissions team - You also speak to the Admissions Team at this stage to get your doubts clarified and also to know more about the program and its placements. The call also helps us figure out your motivation and intent towards the course. Step 3: Within 3-4 working days, you will get your results. And if accepted, you can complete the payment formalities and enroll and start your journey towards a fantastic career!

mainEntity.name: I have just taken my final exams and have not received my degree yet. Can I still apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can discuss this with your Admissions Counselor. To be eligible for the program, you need to be available for the next 6 months for full-time training & then full-time employment after completion of the program.

mainEntity.name: What do I do if I don't have a Pan Card/Adhaar Card?

acceptedAnswer.text: To ensure a smooth process, it is mandatory that you have your Aadhar/PAN card handy. If you're considering the EMI option, our EMI partner will need these documents to assist you further.

mainEntity.name: When do the placements start?

acceptedAnswer.text: The placement process begins upon the completion of your course which is dependent on your clearing the tests and interviews as outlined by the Assessment Center. However, the placement drive begins in the last leg of the program and runs for a few weeks alongside additional sessions/ tests / interviews / sessions also called the Finishing School.

mainEntity.name: Is the Marketing Launchpad - Emerging Talent a job guarantee digital marketing course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marketing Launchpad is designed to set you on the path to success, although we want to clarify that it's not a job-guarantee program. With over 3300+ students placed in roles earning 4.5L or more, we're proud to be the industry's largest and most respected trainer and supplier of marketing talent. Your success is our success, and we're committed to helping you find the right job opportunities, not just side projects or freelance work. But we also want to be honest with you. Succeeding in Kraftshala requires your dedication and hard work. We invite you to talk to our alumni or watch their videos here to get a full understanding of what's expected. You will need to put in the effort, but we'll be right there to support and cheer you on. And if things don't work out, we're committed to sharing that responsibility with you. If you don't secure a placement earning 3L and more within 15 months of completing the training, we'll refund 60% of your fee. All refunds will be in accordance with our terms and conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get placed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total 60% of our students get placed by Week 6 of the placement drive. Total 80% of students get placed by Week 8 of the placement drive. Remaining 20% get placed over the next 4-6 weeks as these are students who typically need more help or have a very specific constraint in terms of location etc.

mainEntity.name: Do I directly get a job of 3.5L+ or do I get to do an internship first?

acceptedAnswer.text: We get both kinds of roles. You can apply to the job after going through all details beforehand. Whether the candidate gets an internship or a full-time offer depends on the company’s requirements, internal process and the candidate's performance in the interview. Thus far, 50% of our students have gotten direct roles post completion of their training and majority of the folks who go into the internships convert it into a full time role of 3.5L or more. The remaining students who are unable to convert their internship are brought back into the process.

mainEntity.name: Am I supposed to apply for all jobs that come in?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You get a certain amount of passes which you can utilize to let an opportunity pass. All the information about the company is made available before you apply. Once applied, you should not back out as it impacts the chances of everyone else as well.

mainEntity.name: After completing the digital marketing course in Hindi, what kind of job roles can I expect to find?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roles which are a mix of both strategy and execution. Companies are a mix of rapidly growing companies, traditional multinationals and both big and medium sized agencies. Examples of a few roles - Digital Marketing Analyst, Performance Marketing Analyst, SEO Analyst, Client Manager, Marketing analyst/executive, etc.

mainEntity.name: If I get an internship first, will that have a stipend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all internships we offer are paid. More importantly, we focus on placing you in roles that provide meaningful work, strong learning, and high-quality exposure.

mainEntity.name: What are the terms and conditions for a refund?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’re eligible for a refund only when you have paid the full pre-paid fees. In this case you will be eligible for: - 60% refund, if you don’t get a job with 3LPA and above within 15 months of program completion. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

mainEntity.name: Will I get a refund if I don’t want to continue with the digital marketing course in Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You are entitled to a 60% refund - if you have paid full-fees upfront and you don’t get a job with 3LPA and above within 15 months of program completion. Any refund of fees will be as per the T&Cs outlined.

mainEntity.name: What is Kraftshala's PGP in AI-Led Marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The PGP in AI-Led Marketing is a 9-month, full-time program conducted on campus in Gurgaon. The program is designed for digital and AI-first careers. Companies today need professionals with real depth, hands-on practice, and the ability to work with AI tools in real business environments. At Kraftshala School of Business, students build campaigns, analyse performance, work with AI tools, and solve real business problems so that they are ready to deliver from day one.

mainEntity.name: How is Kraftshala's PGP in AI-Led Marketing different from a traditional MBA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many traditional MBA programs rely heavily on lectures and case discussions and may struggle to keep pace with how businesses operate in a digital and AI-driven world. The PGP in AI-Led Marketing is designed as a practical MBA alternative focused on real work rather than classroom-only learning. Students spend more time building campaigns, analysing data, using AI tools, and solving real business problems that companies face today.

mainEntity.name: Why should I choose PGP in AI-Led Marketing over a traditional MBA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Companies increasingly value depth, proof of work, and the ability to solve real problems using AI. This program focuses on building those capabilities. Instead of mainly studying frameworks, students build campaigns, analyse data, and solve real business problems using AI tools. By graduation, students have real work to demonstrate in interviews and gain practical skills while spending less time and lower overall cost compared to many traditional MBA programs.

mainEntity.name: Who is the program best suited for?

acceptedAnswer.text: The PGP in AI-Led Marketing is designed for people early in their careers who want to build strong capabilities in modern marketing and business growth. This typically includes final-year students, recent graduates, and professionals with up to two or three years of experience who want to work in digital-first companies, brands, agencies, or high-growth startups.

mainEntity.name: What qualities do you look for in applicants?

acceptedAnswer.text: The admissions process focuses less on perfect resumes and more on how applicants think. The program looks for curiosity about how businesses work, strong problem-solving ability, and a sense of ownership toward learning and growth.

mainEntity.name: What kind of peer group can I expect?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program admits a small cohort of around 30 students, allowing a selective admissions process and close collaboration among peers. Students usually come from diverse academic backgrounds but share a strong interest in building careers in digital-first businesses.

mainEntity.name: What outcomes can I expect after completing the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graduates leave the program with a clear understanding of how growth happens inside businesses and the ability to demonstrate this capability in interviews. Based on the roles the program prepares students for, average outcomes are expected to fall in the ₹6.5–7L range in top companies, with some roles reaching ₹11–12L. Students with prior relevant experience may see salary increases of 50–100%.

mainEntity.name: What kind of roles will I get after the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graduates typically move into roles across growth, marketing, and digital strategy. These may include performance marketing, ecommerce growth, brand and communication strategy, digital media planning, content systems, and marketing analytics across consumer brands, agencies, and digital-first companies.

mainEntity.name: How do Kraftshala outcomes compare to traditional MBA outcomes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many MBA programs take two years and involve significantly higher fees, with outcomes varying widely across institutions. Kraftshala programs focus on building practical capabilities and preparing students for roles companies hire for today. Over the last decade, the institution has delivered strong placement rates and career outcomes across marketing and revenue roles.

mainEntity.name: How does the program ensure real industry exposure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Industry exposure is integrated into the program through real projects, practitioner-led industry sprints, and immersive learning experiences where students observe how decisions are made inside companies. This ensures learning connects directly to real business environments.

mainEntity.name: What is the duration and format of the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program runs for nine months and is conducted full-time on campus in Gurgaon. Learning combines structured coursework, applied projects where students execute real campaigns, practitioner-led industry sprints, and industry immersions so that concepts and execution reinforce each other.

mainEntity.name: Will I receive a degree or certificate after completing the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: Students who successfully complete the program receive a Post Graduate Program certificate called INDUSTRYCreds™ from Kraftshala School of Business. The program focuses on building practical capability and career readiness rather than following a traditional academic degree structure.

mainEntity.name: What is the fee for the program and how is it paid?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program fee is ₹3.7L plus 18% GST. Kraftshala operates with placement accountability. If a graduate secures a role below the defined minimum salary threshold, 60% of the program fee is refunded.

mainEntity.name: Why is the Kraftshala PGP in AI-Led Marketing priced the way it is?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing philosophy is to charge the lowest fee required to run a high-quality institution sustainably. Instead of spending heavily on infrastructure or marketing optics, the institution invests primarily in practitioners, continuously improving the marketing syllabus, and building strong career support systems.

mainEntity.name: What are the eligibility criteria for applying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Applicants should hold a bachelor's degree, although final-year students graduating before the program ends may also apply if they can commit to the full-time on-campus program. The program is typically suited for individuals with zero to three years of experience who want to build careers in AI and digital-first marketing roles.

mainEntity.name: What is the admissions process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The admissions process begins with an online application followed by a short screening exercise where applicants analyse a marketing communication. Shortlisted applicants then have a conversation with the admissions team and a personal interview with the program team. Based on the evaluation, applicants receive an admit, waitlist, or decline decision.

mainEntity.name: Where is PGP in AI-Led Marketing conducted? Is it residential?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program is conducted on campus in Gurgaon, one of the major hubs for digital businesses and marketing teams in India. Being located in this ecosystem allows students to interact with industry practitioners and participate in sessions and projects connected to real business environments. Classes typically run for about five hours a day, with additional time spent on projects, immersions, and challenges.

mainEntity.name: Is accommodation available for students?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The admissions team can guide students in finding PGs and housing options close to the campus. Many students prefer staying nearby to fully participate in the immersive program schedule.

mainEntity.name: Can I speak with someone before applying?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can connect with the admissions team to understand whether the program is the right fit, ask questions about career paths, or arrange a campus visit. You can call +91-7827135490 to set this up.

mainEntity.name: Why should I choose Kraftshala School of Business’s PGP in AI-Led Sales, Marketing and Business over a traditional MBA?

acceptedAnswer.text: For better ROI, faster. Let us explain - If you are getting an admission in the top 20-30 colleges of the country, you should take it up if you can afford it. But if not, the ROI beyond that starts to look very bad. You spend 10-12L in fees and get very mediocre jobs of 5-7L CTC. Placement rates have also been plummeting across most colleges with no accountability at the institute’s end. Kraftshala, from Day 1, has been focused on driving placement outcomes for EVERYONE and not just doing lip service by placing only the top 5-10% of the students. Kraftshala School of Business’s PGP in AI-Led Sales, Marketing and Business has been designed in such a way that by the end of the program, you will be equipped with all the skills necessary to land and succeed in a top tier B2B / FMCG /SaaS Sales, Category Management or B2B Marketing role. Placement Rates, which is % of students placed is what we chase and optimize for. We take accountability by promising that if your job < 7.5L, you get most of your fee refunded.

mainEntity.name: Should I take up this program online or offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are great! If you can afford to be in Gurugram for 9 months, we would recommend you be with us on campus. The experience of learning in a physical space is very fulfilling and we expect the outcomes to be better (average CTC should be 11.5L+) than offline because of that reason. Having said that, online is great too and has delivered exceptional outcomes thus far. Online allows us to keep the program fees lower and you get to meet different peers and experts irrespective of their location.

mainEntity.name: Can I self-pace this MBA equivalent Sales and Marketing Course?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The PGP in AI-Led Sales, Marketing and Business is a full-time program. You have full day classes, projects, workshops and small group coaching on functional and behavioral aspects. So, self-pacing this program is not an option.

mainEntity.name: What is the eligibility criteria for Kraftshala School of Business’s PG Program in Sales, Marketing and Business Leadership?

acceptedAnswer.text: To be eligible for PG Program in Sales, Marketing and Business Leadership, you must-have: Graduation: You should have completed your graduation. If you’re in the final year, you may apply provided you complete your graduation by the time the program training concludes. Work Experience: Experience doesn’t matter. We value potential and intent over years. Admission process looks for: Ability to communicate impactfully with a logical flow and brevity, high ownership demonstrated through your past experiences, and learning agility which keeps you curious, but also reflective and humble.

mainEntity.name: I’ve just completed/will be completing my undergraduate studies. Is Kraftshala School of Business’s PGP in AI-Led Sales, Marketing and Business a right fit for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Work experience is not a mandatory requirement for admission. If you feel you have demonstrable leadership potential, we encourage you to apply to this PG Program in Sales and Marketing meant to help you land high potential sales and marketing roles! As long as you put in the work and build your skills, results will follow - e.g. A student has achieved CTCs of 22LPA post completion of her training.

mainEntity.name: What's the minimum qualifying marks in past academic results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kraftshala School of Business does not have a minimum marks requirement. We focus on your learning, experiences, and performance in the admission process.

mainEntity.name: Is there an age limit for entry?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no age limit for entry. However, the programme is most suitable for those who are at an early stage in their careers. If you have more work experience, we encourage you to get in touch with the admissions team at contact@kraftshala.com, who will evaluate your profile and advise you accordingly.

mainEntity.name: I don't have an undergraduate degree. Can I still be considered for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: To enrol in the program, applicants must have completed their graduation or be in their final year, with graduation expected to be completed by the time the program training concludes.

mainEntity.name: Are all candidates interviewed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Post the application and conversation with our Admissions team, candidates are shortlisted for interviews. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview.

mainEntity.name: If my application has been unsuccessful, may I reapply in the next round?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unsuccessful applicants can reapply for the next round. You should be asking for feedback though, work on it and only then reapply.

mainEntity.name: How do i apply for scholarships for admission in Kraftshala’s PG program in Sales, Marketing and Business Leadership?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kraftshala offers Scholarships under 6 categories. Scholarships are decided based on your past background and your performance in the admission process. You can check your eligibility with your counselor. If you’ve got the skill, we will not let financing get in the way of your aspirations. Kraftshala Changemakers Scholarships are decided based on your past background and your performance in the admission process. Since they will only be rolled out to 5% of the batch, we will look at a bunch of things - Screening Test scores, your intent towards Kraftshala and how you can contribute to our alumni community. If you get the Scholarship, you are eligible for a fee waiver of ₹40,000 on your program fees. The Scholarship discount cannot be combined with any other discount (e.g. Propel Discount). Please note that students enrolling through Scholarships are not eligible for refunds as they are anyways coming in at a lower fees.

mainEntity.name: What are the fees and financing options?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fees for the program is ₹268000 for online (EMIs starting from ~₹11,762/month) and 445000 for offline (EMIs starting from ~₹19,531/month). The program fee can be paid through all common online modes of payment like credit card, UPI etc.

mainEntity.name: Can I get a refund if I don't want to proceed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, fees once paid cannot be refunded. The only eligible clause of a refund is when you don't get placed after being active and participating in all training and placement processes and still being unable to get placed at the minimum CTC promised.

mainEntity.name: Will I get placements post completion of the PG program in Sales, Marketing and Business Leadership?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of Kraftshala’s programs are focused on placements as an outcome. You will have to put in the work in the program and once you do, you can definitely expect great outcomes. Average CTC of our earlier batches of PGP in AI-Led Sales, Marketing and Business was 10.64 LPA and highest CTC went upto 22LPA. We strongly believe that the job of institutions is not just to help candidates get a degree or a certificate but to actually improve employability for you which should culminate in an excellent job post completion. We thereby take ownership of the entire process from admission to training to placements in-house and dont leave you to fend for yourself. Like all Kraftshala’s programs, this sales and marketing course also comes with a placement accountability pledge, which means that if you don't get a job with a minimum CTC, we refund 60% of your fee back.

mainEntity.name: Do I directly get a job of ₹7.5L or do I get to do an internship first?

acceptedAnswer.text: We get both kinds of roles. You can apply to the job after going through all details beforehand. Whether the candidate gets an internship, traineeship or a full-time offer depends on the company’s requirements, internal process and the candidate's performance in the interview. Thus far, 50% of our students have gotten direct roles post completion of their training and majority of the folks who go into the internships convert it into a full time role of 7.5L or more. The remaining students who are unable to convert their internship are brought back into the process.

mainEntity.name: When do the placements start?

acceptedAnswer.text: The placement process begins upon the completion of your program which is dependent on your clearing the tests and interviews as outlined by the Assessment Center.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get placed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Historically, we have seen the following trend for our programs: Total 60% of our students get placed by Week 6 of the placement drive. Total 80% of students get placed by Week 8 of the placement drive. Remaining 20% get placed over the next 4-6 weeks as these are students who typically need more help.

mainEntity.name: Am I supposed to apply for all jobs that come in?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. You get a certain amount of passes which you can utilize to let an opportunity pass. All the information about the company is made available before you apply. Once applied, you should not back out as it impacts the chances of everyone else as well.

mainEntity.name: Will I get a degree or certification at the end of the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: At the end of the program, you will receive an INDUSTRYCreds™ certificate from Kraftshala School of Business. We are an autonomous business school. This means we are not affiliated with the UGC or AICTE, and we do not award a traditional MBA degree or a PGDM diploma. Instead, this is a 9-month Post Graduate Program (PGP). This is an intentional choice. Affiliation with regulatory bodies requires institutions to follow fixed norms around infrastructure, faculty, and curriculum, which can make it harder to adapt to rapidly evolving industry needs. Operating independently allows Kraftshala School of Business to stay flexible and keep the program aligned with what the industry actually demands.

mainEntity.name: If I get an internship first, will that have a stipend?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all internships we offer are paid. More importantly, we focus on placing you in roles that provide meaningful work, strong learning, and high-quality exposure.

mainEntity.name: What if I don't want to move cities? Can I get a job in one specific city itself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sales & Marketing roles require people who are flexible and willing to travel. So we recommend that at the start of your career, you are mobile. But, if you have a constraint to be in one of the following cities for your placements (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore), then you can opt for our Location Specific model once you get selected. Within this, you will have to pay an additional amount of ₹25,000 + GST for Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Bangalore. You can make this decision at the time of enrolment or before moving to placements. In case you opt for this, you will need to pay additional fees. This fee is to account for the additional effort that the Kraftshala team will put in to bring in more companies operating in a given location as well as the additional risk that the team assumes in placing students in a particular city.
